newsitem.title: GREECE: HELLENIC AEROSPACE INDUSTRY HAS A NEW BOARD.
newsitem.headline: HELLENIC AEROSPACE INDUSTRY HAS A NEW BOARD.

text.p: State Hellenic Aerospace Industry (EAB) said in a statement that its new board of directors came to a body on March 5.
Lefteris Moshopaidis, the former financial director and deputy general manager of the Oiko group of construction and furniture firms, was elected chairman, it said.
George Nikiforos, who retired from the Greek Air Force in 1994 and has extensive experience in management and international businesses, was elected managing director.

Pavlos Papayiannopoulos, representative of the general accounting office, Fotis Agadakos and Spyros Zouganelis union representatives, George Babanikas, laywer, George Basoulis, Air Force officer and Theodosis Stergiou, economist, are the other board members, it said.
